newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary 1-mo BUBOR rate up 0.01 pct, rest steady.
newsitem.headline: Hungary 1-mo BUBOR rate up 0.01 pct, rest steady.

text.p: Hungary's Budapest Interbank Offered Rates (BUBOR) rose for the one-month maturity and remained steady for the three- and six-month maturities, the National Bank of Hungary said on Monday.
The one-month rate was set at 21.29 percent, up 0.01, while the three-month rate remained steady at 21.15 percent and the six-month rate was also unchanged at 21.01 percent.
Note: Due to technical difficulties, the NBH's "BUBOR" Reuters page was not updated on Monday, the NBH said.
